articles.title: Saturn's Secret Shape: A Giant 10-Sided Storm!
articles.summary: Saturn has a giant 10-sided wave near its south pole! It's like the famous hexagon at the north pole, but new. Scientists are watching it grow. What will it do next?

articles.title: Giant Iceberg Crashes Into an Island—and Survives!
articles.summary: A huge iceberg as big as St. Thomas broke off Greenland's Petermann Glacier. It slammed into Joe Island but didn't break! Scientists are watching what happens next.

articles.title: The Duck with a Blue Bill That Almost Disappeared—and Came Back!
articles.summary: White-headed ducks have bright blue bills and crazy dances. In Spain, they nearly went extinct (only 22 left!) but now there are 2,500. But they're still endangered.
